title: Virtual On: Cyber Troopers
overview: Japan's no.1 coin-op of 1996 explodes on to Sega Saturn! 8 massive cyber-troopers clash in a gladiatorial battle of devastating proportions. Launch missile attacks across stunning 3D arenas or pounce on your opponent for gruelling close-range combat. 2 player vertical or horizontal split-screen action and all the arcade-original features!
